sloka: श्लेष्मातकमयः दिष्टो देवदारुमयः तथा ।द्वावेव तत्र विहितौ बाहु व्यस्त परिग्रहौ ॥१-१४-२३॥
transliteration: śleṣmātakamayaḥ diṣṭo devadārumayaḥ tathā ।dvāveva tatra vihitau bāhu vyasta parigrahau ॥1-14-23॥

translations.english: These twentyone sacrificial posts, each measuring twentyone 'aratni' height, were welldecorated wrapped in a piece of cloth.
